cohort: 261 Chinese women aged 35 and above who delivered between January 1st and June 30th, 2021.
finding: Overweight women at advanced maternal age showed a significantly higher risk of gestational diabetes mellitus and cesarean section, with specific associations depending on BMI gain during pregnancy.
mod_finding: The risk of cesarean section was significantly higher in overweight women, particularly when their BMI gain during pregnancy exceeded 6kg/m2.
